s: Tepillat hammoed tzarik lesadder ubo seip echad: tepilla shel moadot veshel rashe chodashim en adam ragil bahen kol kak, mippene sheeno mitpallel otan tadir ella lipraqim, lepikak tzarik lehasdir otan mittechilla qodem sheyyitpallel, kede shettehe tepillato shegura bepiv. Veakshav nohagim lehaqel bazeh. Veyesh shellimmedu zekut alehem lomar, shello hitzriku lehasdir ella keshemmitpalelin beal peh, abal keshemmitpalelin mittok hasseper — en tzarik lehasdir, shehare roeh mah shemmitpallel. Umikkol maqom, tepilla shetztzarik lehabin perush haddebarim vadday tzarik lilmod ulehasdir techilla, sheen seper moil lo bazeh, biprat bepiyyutim shechamur perusham:
